oneOf.description:
vatio's own estimate for a day whose prices are not published yet: the average
of recent published days of the same kind (see `method`). It is not Red
Eléctrica data, and not a forecast of the weather or the market.

DayKind.description:
The kind of day, which decides which past days an estimate is averaged from.
Public holidays get no special treatment: one that falls between Monday and
Friday counts as a weekday.

oneOf.description:
PVPC 2.0TD: the energy term of the regulated household tariff. It carries the
cost of energy and the energy share of tolls and charges; taxes come on top. Hourly.
Day-ahead wholesale market price for the Spanish zone. Quarter-hourly.

OutlookBest.description: The cheapest window of an outlook and what its price rests on.

basis.description:
`published` when every price inside the window was published by Red Eléctrica.
`estimated` when any part of the window falls on an estimated day: its mean
is then vatio's estimate, not Red Eléctrica data.

end.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

mean_eur_per_mwh.description: Time-weighted mean price over the window.

start.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

starts_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until this window begins (0 = start immediately).

basis.description:
`published` for today, and for tomorrow once Red Eléctrica has published it.
`estimated` for the days after the last published one.

cheapest.description:
The cheapest window that lies entirely within this day; for today, within what
is left of it. Null when a run of the requested length does not fit there. On
an estimated day its mean is vatio's estimate, not Red Eléctrica data.

estimated_from.description:
The published days this day's estimate is the average of, `YYYY-MM-DD`, newest
first. Empty for a published day.

OutlookMethod.description: How the days without published prices were estimated.

days_averaged.description: How many published days each estimate is the average of.

name.description:
Always `same_kind_days`: each clock hour of an estimated day is priced at the
mean of that clock hour over the most recent published days of the same kind,
weekdays for a weekday and weekend days for a weekend day.

OutlookSpan.description: The time span an outlook searched.

from.description: Earliest allowed start: the start of the current minute.

until.description: Latest allowed finish: the end of the last estimated day.

PriceWindow.description: A candidate run window `[start, end)` and what energy costs on average inside it.

end.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

mean_eur_per_mwh.description: Time-weighted mean price over the window.

start.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

starts_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until this window begins (0 = start immediately).

Source.description: Where a document's data came from. Every document lists its sources.

cached.description: True when served from the local cache instead of the network.

fetched_at.description: When this program retrieved it from upstream.

name.description: Publisher of the data. Cite it when you reuse a figure.

updated_at.description: When the publisher last updated this data. Cite it along with the name.

url.description: The upstream request that produced it.

description:
The cheapest time to run something for a fixed duration over the next several days.

Red Eléctrica publishes prices one day ahead, so only today and, from the evening,
tomorrow have published prices. The days after that are estimated by vatio from
recent published days (see `method`), and published and estimated days are
searched together. Everything marked `estimated` is vatio's own estimate, not Red
Eléctrica data and not a forecast: check again once the day is published.

at.description: The instant this answer was produced.

best.description:
The cheapest window in the whole span. It may cross midnight, and so differ
from every entry of `days`.

days.description: Every day searched, in order: the published days first, then the estimated ones.

duration_minutes.description: Length of the run asked for.

market.description: Always `pvpc`: the outlook covers the regulated household price only.

sources.description:
The published prices used, both those searched and those the estimates are
averaged from.

warnings.description:
Abnormal conditions that affected the answer, in plain words. Empty when
there were none.
